answer_1.quote: Unlike previous work, this paper focuses on the capabilities of ChatGPT in translating English poetry into modern Chinese poetry.

answer_2.quote: For our automatic evaluation, we used SacreBLEU, BERTScore to evaluate the performance of different candidate translations, as BLEU tends to give very low scores.

answer_3.quote: Building on this foundation, we employed GPT-4 to evaluate various translations based on the human evaluation criteria we established.
methods: evaluation based on human evaluation criteria

answer_4.quote: We invited six judges to evaluate the experimental results of eight modern English poems translated under eight different prompts. These judges are Chinese professional poets born between the 1960s and 1990s, who are members of the Chinese Writers Association.
answer_4.guideline: We assess candidate translations comprehensively, focusing on eight key aspects, ranging from overall impact to specific details: Overall Impression, Similarity, Fidelity, Line-breaking, Meaningfulness, Poeticity, Accuracy, and Errors.
